solution.title: Enterprise Application Management Governance & Operating Model (Microsoft Endpoint / Intune)

products.name: Enterprise Application Management Governance & Operating Model (Microsoft Endpoint / Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: The governance and operating model for your Intune application estate — ownership & RACI, an intake workflow, an Application Review Board with real decision rights, standards, risk-tiered change control, a tiered support model, and the scripts that prove it works. Not packaging mechanics — the accountability layer above them.
products.description:
Stop asking "who owns this app, and who said we could deploy it?"

Most teams can package and deploy an application. Almost none can say who owns it, who approved it, on what evidence, and who supports it. So the estate quietly fills with orphaned apps assigned to groups nobody maintains, apps never security-reviewed, apps deployed past their licence, and apps kept alive by one engineer who "just knows." Better tooling does not fix this — the missing piece is an operating model. This package is that model: named roles, a controlled front door, a review board that can actually say no, published standards, ringed change control, and a support model with real escalation — every decision expressed as a concrete object inside Intune and Entra so the platform enforces it, not a slide deck.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested operating model as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin and their leadership can stand up end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell that reads and measures your real estate.

  • Simpler — fourteen ordered steps with full navigation paths; every role, group, scope tag, and forum is named exactly and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable governance consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable as a permanent capability your team keeps.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with eight explicit pass/fail gates, so you prove the model on one business unit before committing the whole estate.

What's inside

  • Ownership & RACI — four named accountabilities per app (Application Owner, Technical Owner, Security Reviewer, Deployment Engineer), an Application Register schema, and the escalation rules that make them real.
  • Intake & the Application Review Board — a controlled front door with return criteria, a standing forum with defined cadence, quorum, evidence packs, and four binding decision types, plus a standard-change rule that removes 60–80% of the board's volume.
  • Standards & risk-tiered change — a published definition of "approved," security-review and licensing criteria, a naming standard, a four-tier change classification matrix, deployment rings, approval-free rollback, and a Change Advisory Board interface.
  • Operational support model — an L1/L2/L3 split defined by action not seniority, severity-based SLAs, and a runbook standard that makes support an organisational asset instead of one engineer's memory.
  • Platform integration — how the model plugs into Intune scope tags, a least-privilege custom role, Entra ring groups, and your security stack (App Control / WDAC, Defender for Endpoint, App Protection) — the interface, not a rewrite of their configuration.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — read-only estate discovery & gap analysis, model validation, a monthly governance scorecard, an approval-evidence exporter for audit, and a gated (-WhatIf) remediation script that stamps ownership and scope tags onto the existing estate.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each rollout feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the model across every business unit and every future application.

Works for Commercial and Government tenants

The process, roles, decision rights, and artefacts are identical for Commercial and US Government (GCC / GCC High / DoD) tenants; only the portal and Graph URLs differ, and every script accepts a -GraphEnvironment USGov switch for the sovereign endpoints.

The bottom line

Every application in your estate owned, approved on recorded evidence, ringed, supported, and measured — a governed operating model built on the Intune and Entra platform you already run, that your team keeps and reuses.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF & Word) — the complete, click-by-click operating model: solution overview, ten requirements, fourteen implementation steps, eight testing gates, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (four read-only; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • APPOPS-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the estate and surface governance gaps (orphaned, broad-target, unowned, unscoped)
    • APPOPS-Validation.ps1 — test the estate against the model's structural gates (scope tags, custom role, groups, per-app conformance)
    • APPOPS-Report.ps1 — produce the monthly Application Governance Scorecard, appendable for trending
    • APPOPS-Export-ApprovalEvidence.ps1 — export the change-approval evidence trail as the review-board / audit evidence pack
    • APPOPS-Remediation.ps1 — stamp owner + approval reference + scope tag onto existing apps (default -WhatIf)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
